verdict.rationale: Fly.io's official CLI, flyctl, is documented (fly-io-probe-4). The quickstart is install flyctl, then run `fly launch` (fly-io-docs-1), which creates, configures and (for most apps) deploys the app from the project directory (fly-io-docs-16), so no dashboard is needed. Community reports of flaky container pushes and stuck deploys (fly-io-comm-5, fly-io-comm-19) concern deploy reliability, not whether CLI deployment exists, and only temper quality; missing for 10: explicit documentation of the subsequent `fly deploy` redeploy workflow, positive independent hands-on corroboration of CLI deploys.
